_doc: Manual board removals the model's automatic rules miss. graduated_mlbam_ids = service-time graduates the AB/IP rookie rule misses (45-day MLB rule, career AB under 131). excluded_mlbam_ids = rookie-eligible but aged-out / quad-A profiles that are no longer ranked prospects on any consensus board. Both are dropped from the prospect board. Curated; document each in notes.

notes.691783: Jordan Lawlar -- debuted 2023 with multiple MLB call-ups; graduated on MLB service time (45-day rule) and dropped from FanGraphs' board, though career AB sits ~121 so the AB-only rule keeps him eligible. Manual graduation.
notes.691728: Zac Veen -- rookie-eligible and mashing AAA, but a 24yo repeating the level (FV40+, off every consensus prospect board since 2023). A quad-A profile, not a dynasty prospect; ValuCast's stats-forward model over-rates the raw production. Manual exclusion.
